WITH LupusPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%confirmed SLE%'
),
InpatientCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS inpatient_num
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM LupusPatients) AND Admission = 'inpatient'
),
OutpatientCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS outpatient_num
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM LupusPatients) AND Admission = 'outpatient'
),
Totals AS (
  SELECT 
    InpatientCount.inpatient_num,
    OutpatientCount.outpatient_num,
    (InpatientCount.inpatient_num + OutpatientCount.outpatient_num) AS total_patients
  FROM InpatientCount, OutpatientCount
)
SELECT 
  inpatient_num AS inpatients,
  outpatient_num AS outpatients,
  ROUND((CAST(inpatient_num AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(total_patients, 0)) * 100, 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Totals
LIMIT 1000;

WITH FirstHalf AS (

sql:
WITH RBC_below_threshold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
Patient_with_care_setting AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.Birthday, p.Admission
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN RBC_below_threshold r ON p.ID = r.patient_id
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'hospital'
    WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS care_setting,
  COUNT(patient_id) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(Birthday)) / 365.25), 1) AS avg_completed_age
FROM Patient_with_care_setting
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting DESC;

arguments.sql:
WITH SulfurAtoms AS (
  SELECT a.id AS atom_id, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.element = 'S'
),
CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE carcinogenic = '+'
),
CarcinogenicSulfurAtoms AS (
  SELECT sa.atom_id
  FROM SulfurAtoms sa
  JOIN CarcinogenicMolecules cm ON sa.molecule_id = cm.id
),
DirectlyBondedAtoms AS (
  SELECT b.atom1_id AS bonded_atom, b.atom2_id AS sulfur_atom
  FROM bond b
  JOIN CarcinogenicSulfurAtoms csa ON b.atom2_id = csa.atom_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.atom2_id AS bonded_atom, b.atom1_id AS sulfur_atom
  FROM bond b
  JOIN CarcinogenicSulfurAtoms csa ON b.atom1_id = csa.atom_id
)

FROM DirectlyBondedAtoms;

first_request.user:
I'm characterizing how strongly rare chemical elements are integrated into the molecular skeleton of carcinogenic compounds. For every carcinogenic molecule that contains at least one atom of an element that appears in no other molecule in the database, I want the number of bonds its atoms of that element take part in. Please judge an element's rarity over every molecule in the database, carcinogenic or not. Return the molecule_id and that bond count for each qualifying molecule, one row per molecule, sorted by molecule_id.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
WITH element_rarity AS (
  SELECT atom.element, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY atom.element
  HAVING molecule_count = 1
),
rare_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, a.atom_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN element_rarity er ON a.element = er.element
),
rare_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM rare_atoms
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT ra.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM rare_atoms ra
  LEFT JOIN bond b ON (ra.atom_id = b.atom1 OR ra.atom_id = b.atom2)
  GROUP BY ra.molecule_id
),
carcinogenic_rare_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE carcinogenic = 1
  AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM rare_molecules)
)
SELECT crm.molecule_id, COALESCE(bc.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count
FROM carcinogenic_rare_molecules crm
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON crm.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
ORDER BY crm.molecule_id;

WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label NOT LIKE '%carcinogenic%'
),
CarbonAtoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'C'
),
EligibleBonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
    FROM bond b
    JOIN NonCarcinogenicMolecules nm ON b.molecule_id = nm.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
CarbonBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN c.atom_id = ca.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END AS other_atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN EligibleBonds eb ON c.bond_id = eb.bond_id
    JOIN CarbonAtoms ca ON c.atom_id = ca.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = ca.atom_id
),
OtherElements AS (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM CarbonBonds cb
    JOIN atom a ON cb.other_atom_id = a.atom_id
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM OtherElements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

arguments.sql:
WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE carcinogenic = 0
),
CarbonElement AS (
    SELECT a.id AS atom_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 'C'
),
EligibleBonds AS (
    SELECT b.id, b.molecule_id, b.atom1_id, b.atom2_id, b.bond_type
    FROM bond b
    JOIN NonCarcinogenicMolecules nm ON b.molecule_id = nm.id
    WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
CarbonOtherBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ca.atom_id = b.atom1_id THEN b.atom2_id ELSE b.atom1_id END AS other_atom_id,

    JOIN CarbonElement ca ON (b.atom1_id = ca.atom_id OR b.atom2_id = ca.atom_id)
),
OtherElementCount AS (
    SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM CarbonOtherBonds cob
    JOIN atom a ON cob.other_atom_id = a.id
    GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element, bond_count
FROM OtherElementCount
ORDER BY element;

For molecule TR377, I'd like a profile of its bond composition, covering single and double bonds only. For each bond kind, please give me: the bond kind symbol, the number of bonds of that kind in the molecule, and the number of element pairs that bond kind joins. Also include the molecule's carcinogenicity label. List the bond kinds from most frequent to least; if two kinds are equally frequent, list them alphabetically by symbol.

arguments.sql:
WITH BondCounts AS (
  SELECT
    b.kind AS bond_kind,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.atom_id1 < b.atom_id2 THEN (a1.element || '-' || a2.element) ELSE (a2.element || '-' || a1.element) END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.id
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom_id1 = a1.id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom_id2 = a2.id
  WHERE m.name = 'TR377' AND b.kind IN (1, 2) -- 1 for single, 2 for double bonds assumed
  GROUP BY b.kind
), 
MoleculeInfo AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    carcinogenicity
  FROM molecule
  WHERE name = 'TR377'
)

SELECT
  CASE bond_kind
    WHEN 1 THEN 'single'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'double'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS bond_kind_symbol,
  bond_count,
  element_pair_count,
  (SELECT carcinogenicity FROM MoleculeInfo) AS carcinogenicity
FROM BondCounts
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC;

WITH AtomBondType AS (
    SELECT 
        c.atom_id,
        b.bond_type
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
AtomBondSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        SUM(CASE WHEN abt.bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN abt.bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM atom a
    LEFT JOIN AtomBondType abt ON a.atom_id = abt.atom_id
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT 
    element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(atom_id) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM AtomBondSummary
WHERE single_bonds > 0 AND multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element_symbol;

first_request.user:
I'm profiling the compound library and want to size the fully saturated portion of each element's atom population - atoms attached only by single bonds behave differently from unsaturated sites. For each element symbol in the database, how many atoms are connected only by single bonds and never part of any multiple bond? Please give me one row per element symbol with the element symbol and the number of such atoms, sorted alphabetically by element symbol. This should cover all compounds in the database. Note that an atom with no bonds at all doesn't count as being connected by single bonds, so exclude those.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
WITH AtomBondCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.element_symbol,
        a.atom_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bond_count,
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM atom a
    LEFT JOIN bond b ON a.atom_id = b.atom_id
    GROUP BY a.element_symbol, a.atom_id
)
SELECT 
    element_symbol,
    COUNT(atom_id) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM AtomBondCounts
WHERE single_bond_count > 0 AND multiple_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element_symbol
ORDER BY element_symbol;

WITH AtomBondRelations AS (
    SELECT 
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        b.bond_type
    FROM atom a
    JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE a.atom_id IN (
        SELECT atom_id FROM atom
        -- Since no explicit atom_id to bond relation, assume an atom is connected by a bond in the same molecule
    )
),
AtomBondSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        atom_id,
        element,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds,
        COUNT(bond_type) AS total_bonds
    FROM AtomBondRelations
    GROUP BY atom_id, element
)
SELECT 
    element,
    COUNT(atom_id) AS fully_saturated_atoms
FROM AtomBondSummary
WHERE single_bonds > 0 AND multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id, a.element_symbol
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a ON b.atom_id_1 = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_order = 3
    UNION
    SELECT b.molecule_id, a.element_symbol
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a ON b.atom_id_2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_order = 3

    SELECT element_symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count

)

FROM element_molecule_count
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;
